papers.title: MQuAKE: Assessing Knowledge Editing in Language Models via Multi-Hop Questions
claims: Tests downstream consequences of edits; MeLLo stores edits externally and checks intermediate answers.
Temporal subset uses selected Wikidata changes, principally position changes.
limitations: Different evidence regime from natural publisher corrections.

papers.title: Memorization vs. Reasoning: Updating LLMs with New Knowledge
claims: KUP uses synthetic updates and evidence with direct and indirect probes.
Includes retrieved and oracle RAG contexts; distinguishes historical retention from current surfacing.
limitations: Synthetic corpora are not natural publisher corrections.

papers.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
claims: Tests updates, temporal reasoning, abstention, and multi-session reasoning.
Separates indexing, retrieval, and reading; uses constructed histories with human question revision.
limitations: Conversation-memory setting differs from publisher corrections.
Failed attempted v3 URL is not evidence of paper absence.

papers.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
claims: Memory controller chooses addition, update, deletion, or no change.
Graph variant marks obsolete relationships invalid; reported evaluation uses conversational LoCoMo.
limitations: Inspected specification does not establish essential-support or alternative-proof semantics.
No negative expressive-power claim and no reproduction.

inferences.residual_question: Does joint correction-target and essential-dependency interpretation improve grounded answers over full-source, competent direct-target, and iterative memory baselines while preserving unaffected and independently supported claims?
inferences.direct_dependent_correction_rule: Retain every explicit dependent correction in all competent baselines; do not suppress one to manufacture propagation benefit.
inferences.algorithmic_gate: Answer improvement beyond strong direct and restarted iterative baselines; internal objective gain alone does not pass.
